# Isaac Lab 3.0 / Isaac Sim 6.0 / Newton References

Downloaded on 2026-05-30 for the Holosoma Isaac Lab 3.0 + Newton migration.

- `isaaclab_migrating_to_3_0.html`

  - Use for Isaac Lab 3.0 breaking changes, multi-backend asset/sensor split, indexed/masked API migration.
- `isaaclab_multi_backend_architecture.html`
  - Source: https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/develop/source/overview/core-concepts/multi_backend_architecture.html
  - Use for backend factory behavior and `isaaclab_physx` / `isaaclab_newton` structure.
- `isaaclab_newton_physics_integration.html`
  - Source: https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/main/source/experimental-features/newton-physics-integration/index.html
  - Use for Isaac Lab Newton integration status and constraints.
- `isaacsim_6_newton_physics.html`
  - Source: https://docs.isaacsim.omniverse.nvidia.com/6.0.0/physics/newton_physics.html
  - Use for Isaac Sim 6.0 Newton backend, asset compatibility, and experimental-core recommendations.
- `isaacsim_6_physics_data_flow.html`
  - Source: https://docs.isaacsim.omniverse.nvidia.com/6.0.0/physics/new_physics_engine.html
  - Use for physics engine data flow and backend integration model.

- `newton_sensors.html`
